cold_start: ~8 s (warm snapshot boot); first session image build ~3m40s
name: Ellipsis
notes: Each sandbox is destroyed at session end; the next session boots from a cached image and runtime state does not carry over. Default session timeout is 1 hour (matching the GitHub App token lifetime), configurable downward but capped at 24 hours.
pricing_model: Per-second metering of vCPU-hour and GB-hour, plus a per-session platform fee equal to 100% of token usage
summary: Ellipsis is a cloud platform that runs managed coding agents (powered by Claude) on behalf of engineering teams. Each agent executes inside its own isolated Linux sandbox in Ellipsis's cloud, with credentials scoped below any developer. Agents are defined as YAML files in the user's repository and triggered on schedules, PR events, mentions, or via API, and are used for code review, automated fixes, dependency bumps, and similar engineering tasks.
